name: raw12_reference
purpose: Reference conditioning using all 12 raw ERA5 predictors.

name: moisture_only
purpose: Measure how much occurrence/intensity skill is retained by moisture predictors alone.

name: thermal_only
purpose: Measure skill retained by thermal predictors alone, especially at high thresholds.

name: dynamics_only
purpose: Measure skill retained by wind/dynamics predictors alone, including possible spatial-organization signal.

name: no_dynamics
purpose: Leave dynamics out while preserving moisture + thermal predictors.

name: no_thermal
purpose: Leave thermal predictors out while preserving moisture + dynamics.

name: no_moisture
purpose: Leave moisture predictors out while preserving thermal + dynamics.

name: raw12_plus_all_derived
purpose: Test whether deterministic derived representations improve optimization/conditioning relative to raw12.

name: raw12_plus_moisture_derived
purpose: Isolate representational effect of relative-humidity vertical contrast.

name: raw12_plus_thermal_derived
purpose: Isolate representational effect of temperature contrasts.

name: raw12_plus_dynamics_derived
purpose: Isolate representational effect of wind speeds and bulk wind differences.
